I found that the `assignPointsToClusters` method in `KMeansPlusPlusClusterer` is calling the `getNearestCluster` method to get the nearest cluster for each point. The NullPointerException in the `assignPointsToClusters` method at line 91 suggests that the `getNearestCluster` method might be returning `null`, causing the NullPointerException when trying to call `addPoint` on a null cluster.

To investigate further, we may need to look at the implementation of the `getNearestCluster` method in `KMeansPlusPlusClusterer`. Let me retrieve the code snippet for that method.
The `NullPointerException` in the `assignPointsToClusters` method of `KMeansPlusPlusClusterer` at line 91 is likely caused by the `getNearestCluster` method returning `null`, leading to the NullPointerException when trying to add a point to a null cluster.

In the `getNearestCluster` method, the nearest cluster is calculated based on the distance from the point to the center of each cluster. If no clusters are passed in or if there is an issue with the calculation, it could result in `minCluster` remaining as `null`. This aligns with the observed NullPointerException.

To proceed with resolving this issue, an enhancement can be made to handle the case where `minCluster` is null in the `assignPointsToClusters` method to avoid NullPointerExceptions. This can be done by checking if `minCluster` is null before trying to add a point to it.

The fix can be applied in the following method:
`org.apache.commons.math.stat.clustering.KMeansPlusPlusClusterer.assignPointsToClusters(Collection<Cluster<T>>, Collection<T>)`

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
